metaDescription: AI Engineer in dmg::media's Innovation Team in London. First-Class Computer Science and AI graduate from Royal Holloway. Applied ML, LLM systems and evaluation.
bioMarkdown:
Hi, I'm Mohamed. I'm an AI Engineer in the Innovation Team at ![dmg::media logo](/icon/dmg-media.png) [dmg::media](https://www.dmgmedia.co.uk/).

Previously, I was Co-Founder & AI Lead at ![Nordlys Logo](/icon/nordlys_logo.png) [Nordlys Labs](https://github.com/Nordlys-Labs/nordlys), where our LLM routing system **ranked above the best published single-model baseline** (Claude Opus 4.5) on SWE-bench Verified in December 2025, and scaled to 500+ users.

I'm a Computer Science & AI graduate of ![RHUL Logo](/icon/rhul.png) [Royal Holloway](https://www.royalholloway.ac.uk/) (First-Class Honours, 2026). My research covered transformer attention and KV-cache compression. I've also worked on adversarial robustness at the ISG Smart Card & IoT Security Centre and sports analytics at ![Stats Perform Logo](/icon/statsperform.png) [Stats Perform](https://www.statsperform.com/).

More in my [CV](/Mohamed_Atoui_CV.pdf).

**Interests:** Machine Learning, LLM Systems, Applied AI, Product Development.
